question.text: A Category III AIF CANNOT provide advisory services except to:

answer.text: Clients of Co-investment Portfolio Manager as per SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020, for investments in investee companies where the AIF invests

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 5 regulatory framework, Manager of AIF cannot provide advisory services except to Co-investment Portfolio Manager clients, subject to conditions. The Trap: Other scopes don't match SEBI restriction. Cross-Exam Context: Critical distinction between AIF and PMS. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Clear separation of AIF-Fund-Manager vs Portfolio Manager advisory is vital for compliance.
